commitmentSemantics.intentCommitmentBindsTo: the canonical identityAnchorPayload verbatim below: package commitRef + identity rule engine hash + attestation module hash + claim-set domain + active cap (ID-CAP-OI002-1) + the 5 pinned CACS claimSetHashes. commitmentSemantics.proofCommitmentRule: proofCommitment == intentCommitment is a PROTOCOL-LEVEL choice in the CoreGuard Identity Anchor v1 spec. EvidenceRegistryV2.anchorProof (lines 244-278) stores proofCommitment and intentCommitment independently and does NOT check equality. The identity is bound to the intent via intentId only; the equality is imposed by the signing authority and is verified OFF-CHAIN by readback (proofAnchors.proofCommitment == intentCommits.intentCommitment). No on-chain enforcement is claimed.
